artwork.rights: Game artwork and PlayStation/PS Vita names remain the property of their respective owners. No ownership or open artwork license is asserted.
artwork.regional_scope: Generic game-level artwork. No image has been verified as region-specific packaging.

title_identity.provider: Vita3K commercial compatibility reports and supplemental public software identity assertions
title_identity.supplemental_evidence: Public TITLE_ID/TITLE software identity assertions from PARAM.SFO. No ownership list, archive paths, game payloads, license keys or package URLs are distributed.

renderer.origin: EmuCoreA tools/render_psp_covers_3d.py, psp-case-v13-clean-spine; template(), warp(), render() continuous print-sheet split
renderer.modifications: Same canonical vertical A-derived case for all sources, shared source/composed UV wrapping spine/bevel/front. Normal artwork directly wraps the full print; outliers preserve complete original art in H-like designed sourced-title/platform panels. Real retail Vita plastic/compact PS+VITA/PSN header; no fabricated game features or ratings.

outlier_composition_visual_reference.scope: Finished H marquee/art/footer visual composition reference. Styled production source code unavailable; no copied arcade feature/edition/credit claims or generated source art.

reviewed_portrait_framing.scope: Crop anchors bound to original SHA/dimensions and reviewed preview SHA. Title/subtitle/main-face visibility reviewed; hair/limb/background/credit margins can trim. Raw originals and flat style remain complete.

vita.credit: Sony Computer Entertainment; vector by Tokyoship/Cbabb7
vita.rights: Public-domain textlogo classification on source page; trademark rights remain with Sony.
vita.crop_policy: Authentic PS VITA letters retained; separate small PlayStation Vita marketing caption excluded to match retail header.

playstation.credit: Sony PlayStation mark; reused from existing EmuCoreA renderer asset
playstation.rights: Trademark remains property of Sony; no ownership or open artwork license asserted.

psn.derivation: Authentic Sony retail globe and wordmark pixels from primary packshot; blue background removed with white-letter red-channel matte and circular globe alpha. Globe colors retained; authentic lettering whitened, no typed replacement, no invented globe.
psn.rights: Sony PlayStation Network trademark; no ownership or open artwork license asserted.
psn.resolution_note: Retains observed source logo detail; proportional resampling does not create new detail.

plastic_reference.rights: Official Sony/Media Molecule retail packshot used as a color reference only; no ownership or universal physical RGB claim.
